references.text: Moses also felt overwhelmed and uncertain when he saw God's glory on Mount Sinai, which mirrors the disciples' fear and uncertainty in the face of Jesus' transfiguration.
Isaiah's reaction when he sees the Lord in His glory, feeling unworthy and afraid, is similar to the disciples' fear during the transfiguration.
This verse describes a similar event in Matthew's Gospel where Peter is afraid and does not know what to say during Jesus' transfiguration.
Luke's description of the disciples' fear during the transfiguration, showing their human reaction to the divine.
